wireEvidence.rationale: Wire evidence is limited to explicitly supported Yosoi JSON APIs; this contract makes no arbitrary-format serializer claim.

Add.rationale: Rust Add implements addition for a type.
Add.equivalentCapability: Python arithmetic is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

AsRef.rationale: Rust AsRef exposes a borrowed view of a value.
AsRef.equivalentCapability: Python read-only properties and owning wrapper views expose the supported value without a Rust borrow API.

Borrow.rationale: Rust Borrow exposes a borrowed view used by generic Rust APIs.
Borrow.equivalentCapability: Python values are passed directly; no separate borrowing operation is part of the Python API.

Clone.rationale: Rust Clone is a value-copying protocol implemented by the source type.
Clone.equivalentCapability: The Python SDK's explicit clone operations and value ownership preserve the documented copied value semantics.

Copy.rationale: Rust Copy is an implicit bitwise-copy marker for eligible values.
Copy.equivalentCapability: Python values are passed by object reference; this Rust marker adds no separate Python operation.

Debug.rationale: Rust Debug provides a diagnostic representation.
Debug.equivalentCapability: Python repr(value) is the corresponding diagnostic representation where the SDK exposes the value.

Default.rationale: Rust Default constructs the documented default value.
Default.equivalentCapability: Python constructors and explicit default factories provide the documented default value.

Deref.rationale: Rust Deref provides transparent target access for Rust syntax.
Deref.equivalentCapability: Python wrapper accessors expose the supported target explicitly.

DerefMut.rationale: Rust DerefMut provides mutable target access for Rust syntax.
DerefMut.equivalentCapability: Python wrapper methods and properties expose only documented mutation operations.

Deserialize.rationale: Rust Deserialize is a format-neutral trait; this parity contract makes no format-neutral wire claim.
Deserialize.equivalentCapability: Only Yosoi's explicitly supported JSON wire APIs are covered by run_serde_conformance.py.

Display.rationale: Rust Display provides a user-facing textual representation.
Display.equivalentCapability: Python str(value) is the corresponding user-facing textual representation where the SDK exposes the value.

Div.rationale: Rust Div implements division for a type.
Div.equivalentCapability: Python arithmetic is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

Eq.rationale: Rust Eq marks equality as reflexive for a value type.
Eq.equivalentCapability: Python equality uses the SDK's value equality behavior for the corresponding type.

Error.rationale: Rust Error integrates an error type with Rust's error-reporting protocol.
Error.equivalentCapability: The Python exception hierarchy and structured error attributes expose the corresponding failure.

From.rationale: Rust From supplies an infallible conversion into a target type.
From.equivalentCapability: The corresponding Python constructor or explicit conversion helper provides the supported conversion.

FromStr.rationale: Rust FromStr parses a textual value with a typed failure.
FromStr.equivalentCapability: The corresponding Python parser or checked constructor exposes the supported textual conversion.

Hash.rationale: Rust Hash supplies a hash consistent with the type's equality implementation.
Hash.equivalentCapability: Python hash(value) is the equivalent only for Python types that expose hashing.

Index.rationale: Rust Index supports indexed access syntax.
Index.equivalentCapability: Python indexed access is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

IndexMut.rationale: Rust IndexMut supports mutable indexed access syntax.
IndexMut.equivalentCapability: Python indexed mutation is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

Into.rationale: Rust Into supplies an infallible conversion from a source value.
Into.equivalentCapability: The corresponding Python constructor or explicit conversion helper provides the supported conversion.

IntoIterator.rationale: Rust IntoIterator supports Rust iteration syntax.
IntoIterator.equivalentCapability: Python iteration is provided only by types that expose the corresponding Python iteration protocol.

Iterator.rationale: Rust Iterator is a stateful iteration protocol.
Iterator.equivalentCapability: Python iteration is provided only by types that expose the corresponding Python iteration protocol.

Mul.rationale: Rust Mul implements multiplication for a type.
Mul.equivalentCapability: Python arithmetic is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

Neg.rationale: Rust Neg implements negation for a type.
Neg.equivalentCapability: Python arithmetic is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

Ord.rationale: Rust Ord supplies total ordering for the type.
Ord.equivalentCapability: Python rich comparisons provide ordering where the SDK exposes it.

PartialEq.rationale: Rust PartialEq compares values according to the type's documented fields.
PartialEq.equivalentCapability: Python == uses the SDK's value equality behavior for the corresponding type.

PartialOrd.rationale: Rust PartialOrd supplies partial ordering for the type.
PartialOrd.equivalentCapability: Python rich comparisons provide ordering where the SDK exposes it.

Send.rationale: Rust Send is a compile-time thread-transfer marker.
Send.equivalentCapability: Python free-threading and runtime behavior are validated by their dedicated runtime checks.

Serialize.rationale: Rust Serialize is a format-neutral trait; this parity contract makes no format-neutral wire claim.
Serialize.equivalentCapability: Only Yosoi's explicitly supported JSON wire APIs are covered by run_serde_conformance.py.

Sized.rationale: Rust Sized is a compile-time type-layout bound.
Sized.equivalentCapability: Python does not expose this Rust type-layout bound as a Python API.

Sub.rationale: Rust Sub implements subtraction for a type.
Sub.equivalentCapability: Python arithmetic is covered only where the corresponding type exposes it.

Sync.rationale: Rust Sync is a compile-time shared-reference thread-safety marker.
Sync.equivalentCapability: Python free-threading and runtime behavior are validated by their dedicated runtime checks.

ToOwned.rationale: Rust ToOwned turns a borrowed view into an owned value.
ToOwned.equivalentCapability: Python wrapper objects already own their retained native values.

TryFrom.rationale: Rust TryFrom supplies a checked conversion with a typed failure.
TryFrom.equivalentCapability: The corresponding Python try_new, validator, or constructor exposes checked conversion and its SDK error.

TryInto.rationale: Rust TryInto supplies a checked conversion with a typed failure.
TryInto.equivalentCapability: The corresponding Python try_new, validator, or constructor exposes checked conversion and its SDK error.
